children: Binance Wallet announced on X that Binance Alpha will be the first platform to feature Canopy (CNPY) on September 7. Eligible users will be able to claim their airdrop using Binance Alpha Points on the Alpha Events page once trading opens. The announcement said further details will be released later.

The notice did not provide additional information about the airdrop terms, claim process, or trading details. It stated that eligible users can use Binance Alpha Points to claim the token after trading begins. No other timing or distribution specifics were included in the update.

title: Binance Alpha to Feature Canopy (CNPY) With Airdrop Claim Available for Eligible Users
